_comment: Kibana action connector that delivers alerts to the SOAR daemon.
url: the daemon listens on 0.0.0.0:8088 on the host. Kibana runs in a
container, so 'localhost' inside that container is the container itself.
172.18.0.1 is the host's address on the Docker bridge network. Confirm
X-SOAR-Token MUST be created as a Secret header, not a Config header.
A Config header is stored in plaintext in the .kibana saved objects index
and is visible to anyone who can read it; a Secret header is encrypted
redacted - substitute the value of SOAR_TOKEN from /etc/soar/soar.env.
name: SOAR Remediator Webhook
